faqs.question: How do I use this page?
faqs.answer: Select the product category, sub-category, and the specific LIC plan you are interested in from the dropdown menus. Then, click 'View Calculator' to be taken to a dedicated page for that plan's premium calculation.

faqs.question: Is this an official LIC calculator?
faqs.answer: No, this is an independent website providing tools for estimation. It is not an official LIC calculator. For exact premium quotes, please contact an authorized LIC agent.

conclusion.title: Plan Your Financial Protection
conclusion.body: Life insurance is a crucial step in securing your family's financial future. Use our tools to get a quick estimate of the premium, making it easier to plan your budget and choose the right policy.
